say:1:1021520001:0.text: The mana sprites hop around as they move. How fascinating...
say:1:1021520001:0.source_cn: 魔花种子走路居然是蹦蹦跳跳的，好神奇……

say:2:1021520002:0.text: If I still had my brush, I'd be able to sketch their adorable walking posture now.

say:5:1021520004:0.text: What?! Where?! Why can't Chippy see it?

say:6:1021520005:0.text: It's right between the two leaves on the biggest mana sprite's head!
